installation.meshDescription: Install and update your extensions directly in your Shopware Administration. Connect your shop to Extension Mesh once to get started.
installation.zipDescription: Download your extension as a ZIP file and install it yourself in Shopware. For updates, download the new version here.

licenses.title: My extensions
licenses.explanation: You can use your extensions through Extension Mesh or download them as ZIP files.
licenses.empty: No extension licenses are currently available for this customer account.
licenses.selectCompatibility: Select a compatible Shopware version to see its releases and changelogs.
licenses.noReleases: No validated releases are currently available for this extension.
licenses.selectStep: Select your shop's Shopware version below.
licenses.downloadStep: Download the extension version you want as a ZIP file.
licenses.installStep: Open “Extensions → My extensions” in your Shopware Administration. Upload the ZIP file, then install and activate the extension.
licenses.zipUpdates: For updates, repeat these steps with the new ZIP file.

account.title: Extension access
account.explanation: Connect your shop to Extension Mesh once. You can then install and update your extensions directly in your Shopware Administration.
account.installStep: Install and activate the Extension Mesh plugin in your shop.
account.connectStep: Open “Extensions → My extensions → Registries” in your Shopware Administration. Add the registry URL and access token below, then save the source.
account.manageStep: Return to “My extensions”. You can install your extensions and apply updates there.
account.zipAlternative: Prefer a ZIP download? Go to my extensions
account.secretWarning: Treat this token like a password. Active clients keep it valid automatically; it expires after 90 days without use.
account.rotateConfirm: The current token will stop working immediately. Update every connected Shopware installation with the replacement token.
account.noEntitlements: No Extension Mesh access is currently available for this customer account.
